content.short: Erable, formerly Cardashift, is a Cardano launchpad for social and environmental impact projects today.
content.description: Erable, previously known through the Cardashift ecosystem, focuses on supporting social and environmental impact projects with Cardano-based launchpad infrastructure. The project aims to create a community-governed product ecosystem where members help identify, select, and accelerate initiatives that address real-world challenges. Its launchpad model is built for projects with measurable impact rather than pure speculation. Erable connects blockchain fundraising, community review, and sustainability-oriented entrepreneurship.
content.meta: Erable is a Cardano impact launchpad for social and environmental projects with community review. Explore Erable on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
